verificationLimits: Weedy and the cannon are not registered as playable; this source/artwork audit does not increase gameplay coverage.
Original component bytes,40 skill ranks,table ranges,animation bindings,hit events and dependency pointers are verified. This does not establish native controller execution order or frame parity.

TriggerTokenSkillWithinManhattanDistance and DamageByDistance are closed native code. Host-ATK transfer,token selection,rupture overwrite/distance sampling and emitted-projectile interruption need bounded runtime policies and regression tests.
Shared simulator shift geometry differs from native continuous knockback. Applying rupture after an instantaneous local shift would omit that movement; the adapter must account for it explicitly.
Token-born lifetime,finish recharge,owner redeployment,captured-victim loss and pending source-cast interruption must be verified before enabling the full kit.
Original Unity particles/audio and equipment modules are not supported; the cannon textures retain the original PMA material and merged RGB/Alpha.

transforms: RGB plus separated Alpha texture merge
atlas texture dimensions normalized and pma: true recorded

owner.normalAttack: Ground targets limited by current block count; INPUT capture, ordinary physical damage without a push buff; max animation scale 1.
owner.s1: Charged physical attack: native Skill hit, uncapped animation scaling (-1), facing-direction knockback then stun; source permits SP recovery if captured targets die.
owner.s2: Permanent mode: ATK addition, forward range extension, BAT percentage modifier (attribute8/formula1), force-level addition; one captured ground victim followed by homing speed10, radius0.9 physical splash.
owner.s3: Manual instant source cast, fixed-time Skill_3 event; one captured ground/air victim, homing speed8, radius1.2 Arts splash; knockback then globally keyed rupture; remote cannon trigger at buff start with Manhattan dist blackboard.
owner.s2M3BAT: 1.2 * (1 + 2.2) = 3.84 seconds before ASPD; the blackboard value is not a flat 2.2-second replacement.

cannon.build: ALL with a direction picker; no overlap with an existing allied occupant
cannon.lifetime: Selected native token talent:15 seconds at E1,20 at E2; useRealBornTimeFromAnim=0.
cannon.normalAttack: One nearest captured ground victim, Attack_Loop/Attack_Down_Loop events, homing projectile speed10, force0 plus selected E2 base_force_level1.
cannon.spAura: Selected E2 range x-5; periodic1 SP every3 seconds, native selfOption2 and target validator retained; owner-recipient semantics require explicit controller mapping.
cannon.remoteSkill: sktok_weedy_token:10 source ranks, isRemoteControlled=1; no independent manual activation button should be inferred.
cannon.finish: Passive flag7 and charge_token[finish] retained; native root withdrawal refund ratio0.5; token-table respawn35 seconds.
cannon.animation: Distinct native Front/Back skeleton and material chains despite identical filenames; Start=Born and Idle=Die aliases. Attack loops use0.167-second transition clips and0.033-second loop attack events.

rupture.source: rupture template DamageByDistance initializes ON_BUFF_START and applies PURE damage ON_BUFF_TRIGGER and ON_BUFF_FINISH.
rupture.identity: Owner/cannon active buffs use overrideKey rupture and overrideType3; original templates and all trigger/duration blackboards retained.
rupture.movement: The native action implementation is not present in asset graphs. Local displacement must be included, but native distance-sampling and overwrite behavior must be mapped and tested rather than inferred from prose.
